newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Economy free of macro-economic imbalances-RBA.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Economy free of macro-economic imbalances-RBA.

text.p: Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) governor Ian Macfarlane said on Thursday the economy was free of major macro-economic imbalances had a fair chance of achieving the sort of sustained growth seen in the 1950s and 1960s.

"Our economy remains free of major macro-economic imbalances at the moment and looking ahead we see we have a fair chance of achieving the sort of sustained growth that we achieved in the 1950s and the 1960s," Macfarlane said.
